title: Welcome to the Journal
excerpt: Notes from The Social Atelier — a curated content studio in Lekki Phase 1, Lagos. Here is what we plan to share.
body:
Welcome to the Journal — a place for notes from the studio.

The Social Atelier is a curated content studio in Lekki Phase 1, Lagos. Our rooms are built for photography, events, podcasts and content production, and each one is designed to work as a finished set rather than an empty space.

What to expect here

We will use this space for practical things: how to get the most out of a session, what each room is suited to, and behind-the-scenes notes from work made here.

  • Guides to preparing for a shoot
  • Notes on individual rooms and how creators use them
  • Occasional updates about the studio

Booking a space

Bookings are handled over WhatsApp so we can confirm availability with you directly. Browse our spaces to see the rooms, then send us the details and we will take it from there.

This is the first post — more soon.
author: The Social Atelier
